title: evolvulus alsinoides var. villosus
intro: Evolvulus alsinoides var. villosus, commonly known as Dwarf Morning Glory or Blue Myrtle, is a species of flowering plant in the Convolvulaceae family. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues, including fever, cough, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Evolvulus alsinoides var. villosus include expectorant, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which help to relieve cough, asthma, and other respiratory conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
